title: Jubilant Slow Vietnamese Dark Chocolate Mi Quang
description: A funky and light Vietnamese dish featuring slow-cooked dark chocolate, served with mi quang noodles, this vegan-friendly meal is perfect for a unique dinner experience. It combines the richness of dark chocolate with the energizing flavors of Vietnamese cuisine.
instructions: In a large saucepan, heat the sesame oil over medium heat.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Remove the tofu from the saucepan and set aside.
In the same saucepan, add the coconut milk, rice vinegar, maple syrup, salt, and black pepper.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the dark chocolate to the saucepan and stir until melted and smooth.
Add the mi quang noodles to the saucepan and cook until they are well coated with the chocolate sauce.
Return the tofu to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the noodles are tender.
Stir in the chopped scallions and serve hot.
